text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — proposing a small PLG experiment next sprint tying free credits + template-driven onboarding + an activation nudge flow. Goal: lift 7-day DAU from trialers by 10% and increase credit redemption rate. Thoughts?

Alex Choi: love it. can we scope a 2x2 test matrix — credit size (small/large) x onboarding template (generic/prompt-pack)? keep sample sizes small to iterate fast.

Samir Patel: yes to 2x2. add routing rule: if they redeem credits and hit embedding endpoint >3 calls, create an inbound lead in HubSpot with tag "credit-activated". we should track MQL velocity.

Leah Gomez: Ops ask — who owns the prompt templates? need content ready by Thu so growth can push via email/drip and in-app bubble.

Maya Chen: Leah, growth will own sending. Alex + Samir to own template drafts. I'll draft the experiment spec and required tracking events.

Alex Choi: Draft templates — 1) "Starter prompts for product search" 2) "Rerank + few-shot copywriter" 3) onboarding checklist card. Short, copy-focused. I'll drop in the marketing Figma. link: https://figma.com/s/abc-prompts

Samir Patel: FYI — growth-bot created experiment stub: Experiment ID: EXP-2026-031, tracking plan updated: event names prefix = marketing.credit_exp.

growth-bot: Experiment EXP-2026-031 created. Variant A: $10 credits + generic template. Variant B: $10 credits + prompt-pack. Variant C: $25 credits + generic. Variant D: $25 credits + prompt-pack. Funnels: credit_redeemed -> first_generated_token -> retention_day7.

Leah Gomez: Nice. For inbound routing: can we add priority flag for accounts with >5 seats or org email domain? Samir?

Samir Patel: yep — add rule: if billing_plan_estimated_seats >=5 OR email_domain in enterprise_list -> assign to sales queue "SMB+" and create lead owner = regional SDR. else default to automation nurture.

Maya Chen: Webinar tie-in idea: run a short "Getting reliable results from open models" webinar targeted to credit recipients on week 2 as an activation nudge. 20‑minute demo + live Q&A. Does that fit timeline?

Alex Choi: fits. we can invite credit redeemers via in-app banner + transactional email. CTA should auto-apply a bonus credit for attending (e.g., +$5).

Leah Gomez: I'll coordinate dates with events calendar. prefer Tue or Thu mornings. I'll also add the webinar registration property to the tracking spec so we can measure conversion uplift.

Samir Patel: measurement checklist: uplift in generate_calls per user, avg tokens per session, 7-day retention_delta, # of leads created (tagged), webinar attend rate. We should capture cohort IDs for A/B analysis.

Maya Chen: solid. next steps: Alex + Samir — finalize templates & tracking by Thu EOD. Leah — lock webinar date and update calendar. I'll publish the experiment brief and notify ops.

Alex Choi: will do. ping me if you want rapid copy reviews. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: tagging growth-bot to create reporting dashboard: KPIs by variant and routing outcome.

growth-bot: Dashboard request queued (dash-2026-13). ETA 2 business days.

Leah Gomez: I'll also add a line to the inbound playbook for "credit-activated" routing so SDRs see context.

Maya Chen: Thanks team — this is small and measurable. I'll follow up with the experiment brief link shortly. :party-popper:
